note: sha256Compress on a real @bsv/sdk Spend. No signature: the witness is the block. Honest digests are independent of the codegen: sha256Compress(IV, padded 'abc') = node SHA-256('abc') (FIPS 180-4 B.1), and a FIPS 180-4 compress reference in packages/runar-testing/src/__tests__/f114-compress-operand-size-vm.test.ts pinned to that value. F-114: the compiled sha256Compress aborts unless the block is 64 bytes and the state 32 bytes. Before F-114 a 60..63-byte block whose honest 64-byte form ends in zero bytes produced the honest digest and Spend accepted it. The interpreter verdict is asserted equal to the Spend verdict on every row.

spends.note: Honest: SHA-256 IV + the FIPS-padded single block of 'abc'; expected = SHA-256('abc').
F-114 near-miss: 65-byte block || 0x01 with the honest digest: refused by the block-size guard.
33-byte state IV || 0x01 with the honest digest: refused by the state-size guard.
31-byte state with the honest digest: refused by the state-size guard.
Honest zero-tail block (the 64-byte block (i*37+11) mod 256 with its last four bytes zeroed); expected from the FIPS reference compress.
F-114 forced near-miss: the 63-byte prefix of the zero-tail block, which Spend accepted with the honest digest before F-114 (short last word zero-extended). Now refused.
